verdict.rationale: The docs show data-residency options: the Voice Agent API runs on EU, AU and India regional endpoints, and EU-specific processing is available at api.eu.deepgram.com. Data-retention control is also documented, since requests can opt out of the Model Improvement Program with mip_opt_out=true. However, the pack has no evidence of HIPAA/BAA support or SOC 2 attestation, which are two of the three compliance pillars in the story. Missing for 10: HIPAA compliance and BAA availability, SOC 2 report/attestation, independent corroboration of compliance posture.
